behavior_change_rationale.7: Coding orchestration: separate process-skill selection from primary runtime coordination.
behavior_change_rationale.9: Coding orchestration: required missing skill remains incomplete rather than being reimplemented by a fallback.
behavior_change_rationale.15: Coding orchestration: process skills do not select runtime roles or models.
behavior_change_rationale.16: Coding orchestration: task-specific missing dependencies do not block independent authorized work.
behavior_change_rationale.17: Coding orchestration: portable plugin methods require no personal role configuration.

clarification_rationale.14: The example-first criterion applies within the proposed design, after the separate constraints section. A concrete load or save behavior example satisfies it; requiring one example to cover the entire load/save lifecycle would add a requirement beyond the design-writing contract. A destination JSON shape alone is not a behavior example.
